A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 22-page paper, including Appendices A–C. Pages 2–22 have identical text and rendered appearance; first-page differences concern affiliations and the arXiv version stamp.

before.justification: v4 reports original alignment experiments in Section 5 and Appendix B, including training-loss comparisons, sentiment and safety evaluations, and KL-divergence measurements.

after.justification: v5 retains those original experimental results in Section 5 and Appendix B, including resistance, rebound, and model-scaling analyses.

M1.justification: The token-tree/Huffman compression protocol in Section 3.2 and the alignment procedures in Section 5 and Appendix B are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Alpaca, TruthfulQA, Beavertails, and IMDb coverage, including the same forward, inverse, and reverse-direction alignment scenarios.

E2.justification: The forward-versus-inverse comparisons and pretrained-model controls are unchanged. Appendix B.2 retains the same PPO, DPO, KTO, and SimPO evaluations.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendix B retain identical snapshot construction, sample-volume schedules, model configurations, pretraining checkpoints, evaluation metrics, and testing procedures.

E4.justification: The analyses of alignment algorithms, KL-divergence evaluation, reverse fine-tuning, model size, and pretraining data volume are identical, including Appendix B.

E5.justification: The standard-deviation shading described in Figures 5–6 is unchanged. Neither version adds or revises run counts, seed information, or other uncertainty-reporting procedures.

E6.justification: Tables 1–3 and all experimental plots retain identical results. For example, Table 1 reports the same Alpaca/Llama2-7B losses of 0.1589 versus 0.2018 for the first inverse/forward comparison.

T1.justification: The definitions, assumptions, theorems, and derivations in Sections 3–4 and Appendix A are identical, as is the mathematical discussion in Appendix C.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about elasticity, resistance, rebound, and their relationships to model size and pretraining data volume.

C2.justification: The result interpretations, limitations in Section 6.1, broader impacts, and Appendix C discussions of transfer learning, mitigation, and unresolved data-volume thresholds are unchanged.

D1.justification: Experimental and implementation disclosures are identical. The model-weight/code access footnote and its link target are also unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, reference list, related-work discussion, and positioning relative to alignment and transfer-learning research are identical.

P1.justification: v5 replaces the single Peking University affiliation with three numbered affiliations identifying two university units and the Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence. Author superscripts and the version stamp change; scientific prose and section order remain identical.

P2.justification: The first-page author block is reformatted for the expanded affiliations, and the arXiv stamp is updated. Figures 1–10, Tables 1–3, and the remaining page layouts are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v5 provides more specific institutional attribution, but the scientific argument, empirical evidence, proofs, limitations, and appendices are identical. The limited first-page update does not meaningfully change the paper's overall quality.
